kbs-kustomz.title: KB's Kustomz
kbs-kustomz.description: A modern business website and content management system built for an automotive body repair and painting business. The platform features a dynamic image gallery, editable business information, service pages, and a secure dashboard for managing website content.
kbs-kustomz.problem: The business needed a professional online presence to showcase its automotive repair and painting work. Managing website content and keeping project photos up to date needed to be straightforward without requiring code changes.
kbs-kustomz.solution: Designed and developed a responsive website with a database-backed image gallery and a secure content management dashboard. Integrated Supabase authentication and PostgreSQL for data management, Google OAuth for sign-in, and Vercel Blob for image storage.
keyFeatures: Paginated gallery with nine images per page
Server-side data handling and cache revalidation
Role-based access controls and database row-level security

technicalChallenges.title: Secure content management
technicalChallenges.description: Implemented authenticated dashboard access and layered authorization using application-level role checks and Supabase Row Level Security to protect business content.

technicalChallenges.title: Image storage and gallery performance
technicalChallenges.description: Integrated Vercel Blob for image storage and implemented pagination, ordered gallery content, and cache revalidation to keep updates consistent.

technicalChallenges.title: Maintainable gallery management
technicalChallenges.description: Built database-backed image ordering and drag-and-drop controls so gallery content could be managed without manually editing source code.

outcomes: Delivered a deployed website tailored to a real local business.
Made gallery and business content updates manageable through a dashboard.
Built reusable experience with authentication, database security, file storage, and deployment workflows.
lessonsLearned: Designing authorization across the application and database layers
Managing cached data and revalidation in the Next.js App Router
Building full-stack features around a real client's workflow
Balancing maintainability, usability, and responsive design

jarvis-bot.title: Jarvis Bot
jarvis-bot.description: A Python-powered Discord bot that integrates the Google GenAI API to bring AI-driven conversational capabilities into a Discord server. The project explores API integration, event-driven bot development, and deploying a persistent application to a cloud-hosted environment.
jarvis-bot.problem: Discord communities can benefit from an interactive assistant that responds to messages and provides AI-generated conversational support directly within their server.
jarvis-bot.solution: Developed a Discord bot in Python that connects to the Goggle GenAI API, processes user interactions, and returns generated responses through Discord. The Bot is hosted on a cloud server via FadeHost.

technicalChallenges.title: Third-party API integration
technicalChallenges.description: Connected Discord interactions to the OpenAI API, coordinating incoming messages with external API requests and generated responses.

technicalChallenges.title: Application hosting
technicalChallenges.description: Explored cloud hosting options to run the bot persistently beyond a local machine, including troubleshooting hosting availability.

technicalChallenges.title: Managing external dependencies
technicalChallenges.description: Worked with third-party API credentials and service dependencies while developing an application that relies on external platforms.

outcomes: Built a working project integrating Python, Discord, and generative AI.
Gained practical experience with API-driven application architecture.
Explored deployment and cloud hosting options for long-running applications.
lessonsLearned: Integrating external APIs into an application workflow
Handling asynchronous interactions and external service dependencies
Deploying and maintaining applications outside a local environment
Understanding the operational challenges of persistent cloud workloads
